activity.notes: Isabella II succeeded Ferdinand VII in 1833 while still a child and remained Queen of Spain through successive regencies and her personal rule until the Revolution of 1868 forced her into exile. ATLAS preserves the constitutional sovereign reign from accession to the effective loss of the throne; her later formal abdication in 1870 occurred after she had ceased ruling Spain.

sources.title: Isabella II of Bourbon, Queen of Spain — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Isabella II's accession in 1833 and her flight to France after the Revolution of 1868.
